name: Alertas de Nodos Correlacionadas (EMA vs Actuador)

parameters.query:
WITH EmaLogs AS (
  SELECT status AS current_status, timestamp AS current_timestamp
  FROM "DeviceLog" WHERE device = 'Weather_Station_ZONA_A'
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
),
EmaPrev AS (
  SELECT status AS prev_status, timestamp AS prev_timestamp
  FROM "DeviceLog" 
  WHERE device = 'Weather_Station_ZONA_A' 
    AND timestamp < (SELECT current_timestamp FROM EmaLogs)
    AND status != (SELECT current_status FROM EmaLogs)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
),
ActLogs AS (
  SELECT status AS current_status, timestamp AS current_timestamp
  FROM "DeviceLog" WHERE device = 'Actuator_Controller'
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT current_status FROM EmaLogs) AS ema_current_status,
  (SELECT prev_status FROM EmaPrev) AS ema_prev_status,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - (SELECT current_timestamp FROM EmaLogs)))::integer AS ema_current_seconds,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((SELECT current_timestamp FROM EmaLogs) - (SELECT prev_timestamp FROM EmaPrev)))::integer AS ema_prev_seconds,
  (SELECT current_status FROM ActLogs) AS act_current_status,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - (SELECT current_timestamp FROM ActLogs)))::integer AS act_current_seconds;
